## Expert Lecture on “Innovative Infrastructure Solutions through Pre-Engineered Buildings”

News Date : 18 Nov 2025News ReportThe Industry Institute Partnership Cell (IIPC), in collaboration with the Department of Civil Engineering, MGIT, organized an expert lecture on“Innovative Infrastructure Solutions through Pre-Engineered Buildings”on18-11-2025, from2:00 PM to 4:00 PMatE-101.The session was delivered byMr. K. Saran Rao, Project Manager, Anuktha Avenues, Hyderabad. Faculty members and students from the Civil Engineering department actively participated in the event.Welcoming the gathering,Dr. G. ChandraMohan Reddy, Principal, highlighted the importance of understanding modern engineering challenges and encouraged students to stay updated with advanced construction technologies.Dr. V. Venkata Ramayya, HoD, Civil Engineering, addressed the relevance of Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEBs) in current infrastructure development and emphasized their growing industrial importance.During the lecture,Mr. K. Saran Raoexplained how Pre-Engineered Buildings offer significant advantages such asreduced construction time,cost-effectiveness,design flexibility, andenvironmental sustainability. He also elaborated on innovative PEB practices and their practical outcomes in modern infrastructure projects.The session was summarized byDr. M. Padmaja, Member, IIPC, Civil Engineering Department.Dr. P. Chandra Sekhar, Convenor, IIPC, proposed the vote of thanks and expressed gratitude to the speaker for the insightful session.

The Industry Institute Partnership Cell (IIPC), in collaboration with the Department of Civil Engineering, MGIT, organized an expert lecture on“Innovative Infrastructure Solutions through Pre-Engineered Buildings”on18-11-2025, from2:00 PM to 4:00 PMatE-101.
The session was delivered byMr. K. Saran Rao, Project Manager, Anuktha Avenues, Hyderabad. Faculty members and students from the Civil Engineering department actively participated in the event.
Welcoming the gathering,Dr. G. ChandraMohan Reddy, Principal, highlighted the importance of understanding modern engineering challenges and encouraged students to stay updated with advanced construction technologies.
Dr. V. Venkata Ramayya, HoD, Civil Engineering, addressed the relevance of Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEBs) in current infrastructure development and emphasized their growing industrial importance.
During the lecture,Mr. K. Saran Raoexplained how Pre-Engineered Buildings offer significant advantages such asreduced construction time,cost-effectiveness,design flexibility, andenvironmental sustainability. He also elaborated on innovative PEB practices and their practical outcomes in modern infrastructure projects.
The session was summarized byDr. M. Padmaja, Member, IIPC, Civil Engineering Department.
Dr. P. Chandra Sekhar, Convenor, IIPC, proposed the vote of thanks and expressed gratitude to the speaker for the insightful session.
